# The emoji the panel draws in colour — exactly these, and nothing else (README "Emoji").
#
# Source: Noto Color Emoji, googlefonts/noto-emoji at tag v2.051, png/128/emoji_u<cp>.png.
# License: Apache License 2.0 (images); see NOTICE beside this file.
#
# Each line: code point (hex), SHA-256 of its source PNG, the emoji, its Unicode name.
# firmware-c6/tools/gen_emoji.py builds emoji_set.c and emoji_img.c from this file and refuses a
# source whose checksum differs; `--check` (CI) regenerates and compares. To add one: append its
# code point on a line of its own, run `gen_emoji.py --pin`, then `gen_emoji.py`. Every emoji
# costs ~2.4 KB of app image (two sizes, RGB565A8), so the set is curated, not complete.
#
# Single code points only. A sequence draws code point by code point (emoji_logic.c): a
# variation selector, skin tone, ZWJ or flag letter takes no room, so a ZWJ sequence shows its
# parts (list them here) and a toned hand its yellow base.
